summary: Backend-only verification of the double-logo bug fix. Added pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_email_footer_fix.py with 19 tests covering: (1) wrap_email() signature has include_footer kwarg with default True; (2) wrap_email() default output contains FOOTER_HTML markers (Tel.:, +382 68 559 776, Marka Miljanova 12, dark strip); (3) wrap_email(include_footer=False) fully excludes FOOTER_HTML while keeping exactly ONE logo (header only, count of euroadria-logo.png = 1); (4) lang/tracking pixel still work; (5) SIGNATURE_HTML_TEMPLATE in team.py contains logo, EuroAdria Corporate Solutions, euroadria.me link, Montaris & Co. d.o.o., Novi Sad + Marka Miljanova 12 + 21000, reg no. 22147382, PIB 115356237, OFFICE PODGORICA + Studentska, OFFICE DÜSSELDORF + Speditionsstraße + 40221; (6) source of routes/team.py::send_lead_email statically confirmed to call wrap_email(..., include_footer=False); (7) emails.py send_contact_email, send_notification_email, followup_email_loop still call wrap_email(content) WITHOUT include_footer=False (i.e. footer stays for those flows); (8) POST /api/team/leads/{lead_id}/email hit live (JWT-authenticated as milena@euroadria.me) returned graceful HTTP 500 with detail 'Email service not configured' (RESEND_API_KEY absent in preview) and no Python traceback/ImportError/NameError/TypeError; (9) unauthenticated request returns 401/403. All 19 tests PASS. Backend logs show no errors from the endpoint call.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: wrap_email(include_footer: bool = True) with `footer = FOOTER_HTML if include_footer else ''` interpolated into the template. Only the Team CRM endpoint passes include_footer=False; all other callers keep the default so their emails still carry the full corporate footer.

SIGNATURE_HTML_TEMPLATE embedded in routes/team.py already provides the full signature block (logo, addresses, reg numbers, offices), so suppressing FOOTER_HTML from wrap_email() is the right way to prevent the duplicate logo/branding.

Minor (pre-existing, not introduced by this fix): JWT_SECRET default in routes/team.py is 26 bytes (below 32-byte recommended for HS256) — pyjwt logs InsecureKeyLengthWarning on every team login. Consider setting a stronger JWT_SECRET in backend/.env.
Nit: the send_lead_email f-string 'EuroAdria Team <noreply@euroadria.me>' has no interpolations, the 'f' prefix can be dropped (cosmetic).

context_for_next_testing_agent: The double-logo bug fix is verified end-to-end at the backend. wrap_email() correctly gates the footer via include_footer flag. Endpoint POST /api/team/leads/{lead_id}/email exercises the include_footer=False path and reaches the Resend send step, then fails cleanly with 500 'Email service not configured' because RESEND_API_KEY is intentionally unset in the preview environment (this is expected). To visually confirm the rendered HTML (only one logo instead of two), you can import emails.wrap_email in a REPL, pass include_footer=False, and grep the output for 'euroadria-logo.png' — count must be 1 (asserted by test). Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_email_footer_fix.py. JUnit XML: /app/test_reports/pytest/email_footer_fix_results.xml.
rca of the issue: Bug: emails sent from the Team CRM /api/team/leads/{lead_id}/email endpoint rendered the EuroAdria logo twice — once inside SIGNATURE_HTML_TEMPLATE (embedded in routes/team.py as the corporate sign-off block after the body) and again inside FOOTER_HTML (defined in emails.py and unconditionally appended by wrap_email()). Fix applied by developer: (a) emails.py wrap_email() gained an include_footer: bool = True kwarg; when False, the FOOTER_HTML section is omitted from the returned template; (b) routes/team.py send_lead_email passes include_footer=False so the top logo (header of wrap_email) remains but the redundant footer with the second logo is suppressed, leaving SIGNATURE_HTML_TEMPLATE as the single sign-off block. Verification: unit tests confirm the output string contains exactly one occurrence of 'euroadria-logo.png' (the header) and zero of the footer markers (Tel.:, +382 68 559 776, dark strip) when include_footer=False; other email flows (contact, notification, follow-up) still call wrap_email(content) without the new arg, so they preserve their footer as before. Mitigation is complete; no further action required.
